init_SLAPAgent: initialize a SLAPAgent with config, device, and task_id for robot manipulation skill prediction
load_models_SLAPAgent: load IPM and APM model weights into the SLAPAgent for interaction and action prediction
predict_SLAPAgent: predict interaction point and action from environment observations using the SLAPAgent predict method
create_interaction_prediction_input_from: convert robot observations into voxelized point cloud input for the interaction prediction module
reset_SLAPAgent: reset the SLAPAgent interaction point and keyframe state to prepare for a new prediction cycle
